name: AISIT Database of Pan-Arctic stable oxygen isotope (delta18O) and barium measurements from seawater, freshwater, rivers, fjords, and precipitation north of 60 degrees North, 1967–2025
description: This database is a curated compilation of stable oxygen isotope (delta18O) and barium measurements from seawater, freshwater, rivers, fjords, and precipitation, covering the pan-Arctic region (here defined as north of 60 degrees North). Data were assembled from 99 published and archived source datasets spanning the Arctic Ocean, Beaufort Sea, Bering Sea, Chukchi Sea, Davis Strait, Barents Sea, Laptev Sea, Kara Sea, East Siberian Sea, Greenland Sea, Svalbard, Greenland fjords, and major Arctic rivers (Yenisey, Lena, Ob, Mackenzie, Yukon, Kolyma). Measurements were collected between December 1967 and August 2025, totalling 45,737 data points, of which 6,504 are freshwater samples and 5,286 are land-based. Each record includes the delta18O value, the measurement standard used (predominantly VSMOW), and associated ancillary data including geographic coordinates, sampling depth, temperature, and salinity where available. 5,531 delta18O records contain total barium measurements. All source datasets have been harmonised to a common schema and subjected to QA/QC processes, with WOCE flags applied where present in the original data. The database was constructed as part of the AISIT programme, funded by NERC and EPSRC, to provide an AI-ready, FAIR-compliant resource for the study of Arctic freshwater sources, hydrological processes, and climate change.

additionalProperty.name: history
additionalProperty.value: Source datasets were identified through a systematic survey of international resources. Open data repositories searched include the NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Arctic Data Center, British Oceanographic Data Centre, Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS) Global Seawater Oxygen-18 Database, University of Utah Waterisotopes Database (waterisotopes.org), GEOTRACES Intermediate Data Product 2025 (IDP2025), PANGAEA, LOCEAN, the NSF Arctic Data Center, Arctic GRO, PAGES CoralHydro2k Seawater delta18O database, and GLODAP (used for cruise identification only; source data retrieved directly). Data were also obtained through direct private communication with data holders. GNIP and GNIR data were not included due to data use agreements; users are encouraged to supplement AISIT with those resources. Each source dataset was assessed for data availability, licensing, and methodological compatibility. Data were extracted and harmonised into a common schema, including standardisation of date-time formats (ISO 8601), coordinate systems (decimal degrees), depth fields (metres below surface, derived via TEOS-10 gsw_z_from_p), and salinity (PSS-78). Delta18O values are reported relative to the standard specified in the O18_Standard column (predominantly VSMOW). QC flags follow the WOCE convention. Boolean flags identify freshwater (Freshwater), BIOPOLE-associated (BIOPOLE), and land-based (Land_Based) samples, the latter determined via point-in-polygon test against a 10 m global coastline using Shapely/GEOS. Database built with Python 3.12; packages: pandas, netCDF4, openpyxl, gsw/TEOS-10, Shapely/GEOS, numpy, pyarrow, matplotlib.

additionalProperty.name: comment
additionalProperty.value: All data were subjected to QA/QC processes. WOCE quality control flags are included where provided by source datasets; where non-standard flags were used, these have been translated to WOCE equivalents (Delta_O18_WOCE_Flag_Translated) and originals preserved (Delta_O18_WOCE_Flag_Original). Missing values are represented by empty fields. Datetime entries without a day have been assigned the first day of the month; entries without a time have been assigned 00:00:00. The delta18O standard is recorded per sample; entries where the standard could not be determined are flagged 'VSMOW (assumed)' and should be treated with caution. Land-based sample positions were flagged using an approximate point-in-polygon method and should be verified manually where precision is critical. Some source datasets were obtained via private communication and are unpublished; these are identified in the Data_Provenance and Database_Citation fields. There is no fixed spatial or temporal resolution; data are discrete point observations. Instrumentation varies by source dataset and includes CTD rosette systems, Niskin bottles, underway towfish systems, and ROVs. The database follows the Croissant metadata standard for AI-readiness, adheres to CF conventions and UCUM units, and is compliant with ISO 19115 Geographic Information Metadata.

cr:recordSet.name: AISIT Database of Pan-Arctic stable oxygen isotope (delta18O) and barium measurements from seawater, freshwater, rivers, fjords, and precipitation north of 60 degrees North, 1967–2025_schema
cr:recordSet.description: Schema for the AISIT pan-Arctic delta-O18 and barium database. Each record represents one discrete water sample with its measurements, WOCE quality flags, and provenance identifiers. Coordinates follow EPSG:4326 (decimal degrees). Depths are in metres below surface (positive down) derived via TEOS-10. Salinity is on the PSS-78 scale. Delta18O is reported in per mil relative to VSMOW unless otherwise stated in O18_Standard.

cr:field.name: Dataset
cr:field.description: Short name of the dataset or file the data was extracted from, used for identification of different datasets within the database

cr:field.name: ISO8601_Datetime
cr:field.description: ISO8601 datetime on which sample was taken, as reported by the data source (note entries without a day have been assigned 01/mm/yyyy and entries without a time have been assigned 00:00:00) | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: Latitude_[degree_north]
cr:field.description: Latitude of sampling position decimalised (-90° to 90° where negative values indicate latitudes South of the equator and positive ones indicate those North of it) | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: Longitude_[degree_east]
cr:field.description: Longitude of sampling position decimalised (-180° to 180°, where negative values indicate longitudes West of the Prime Meridian, and positive values indicate longitudes East of it) | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: Temperature_[cel]
cr:field.description: The sensor derived temperature of the sample, ITS-90

cr:field.name: CTD_Temperature_WOCE_Flag
cr:field.description: QC flag for the temperature (included where present)

cr:field.name: CTD_Pressure_[dbar]
cr:field.description: CTD/sensor derived pressure of the sample | Note: Some samples may have both pressure and depth but should have a minimum of one or the other, should be assumed to be a surface measurement where not present in freshwater samples

cr:field.name: Depth_From_Pressure_[meters_below_surface]
cr:field.description: Depth value derived from the CTD pressure and latitude using the following function (implemented in python) https://www.teos-10.org/pubs/gsw/html/gsw_z_from_p.html

cr:field.name: Sample_Depth_[meters_below_surface]
cr:field.description: Depth (meters below surface) at which samples were taken, increases positively with increasing depth below water's surface | Note: Should be assumed to be a surface measurement where not present in freshwater samples

cr:field.name: Combined_Depth_[meters_below_surface]
cr:field.description: Combined column of Depth_From_Pressure and Sample_Depth; where both are present, Depth_From_Pressure takes precedence | Note: Should be assumed to be a surface measurement where not present in freshwater samples

cr:field.name: Delta_O18_[permillle]
cr:field.description: The delta O18 measurement of a sample as compared to the reference standard listed in the "O18 standard" column | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: Delta_O18_WOCE_Flag_Translated
cr:field.description: The WOCE flag for the DELO18 column measurement datasets with non standard flags have been translated into their WOCE alternative (included where present) | Note: Datasets where non-standard WOCE flags have been used (and the meanings provided) have been translated into their WOCE equivelants

cr:field.name: Delta_O18_WOCE_Flag_Original
cr:field.description: The WOCE flag for the DELO18 column measurement, here datasets with non-standard flags have been left as they were originally listed (included where present)

cr:field.name: O18_Standard
cr:field.description: The specified standard against which the O18 measurement was taken, any data entry for which the O18 Standard could not  be found is labelled as "VSMOW (assumed)", the standard for the entries cannot be found and should therefore be treated as VSMOW but treated with caution | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: Barium
cr:field.description: The Barium measurement of a sample | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: Barium_WOCE_Flag
cr:field.description: The WOCE flag for the Barium column measurement

cr:field.name: Barium_Units
cr:field.description: Units that the associated Barium measurement was reported in | Note: Present for all samples

cr:field.name: CTD_Salinity_[standard_salinity_units]
cr:field.description: The sensor/CTD derived salinity of a sample | Note: All non-freshwater samples should contain a CTD or bottle salinity value

cr:field.name: CTD_Salinity_WOCE_Flag
cr:field.description: WOCE flag for the sensor derived salinity (included where present)

cr:field.name: Bottle_Salinity_[standard_salinity_units]
cr:field.description: The bottle derived salinity for a sample | Note: All non-freshwater samples should contain a CTD or bottle salinity value

cr:field.name: Bottle_Salinity_WOCE_Flag
cr:field.description: WOCE flag for the bottle derived salinity (included where present)

cr:field.name: Cruise_ID
cr:field.description: The cruise name or ID on which the samples were taken

cr:field.name: Station_ID_Name
cr:field.description: The unique identifier for the station at which the samples were taken

cr:field.name: Site_Number_Name
cr:field.description: The unique identifier for the site at which the samples were taken (only present for land based sampling)

cr:field.name: Sample_ID
cr:field.description: The unique identifier for the sample taken

cr:field.name: Cast_Number
cr:field.description: The cast number the sample was measured in

cr:field.name: Bottle_Number
cr:field.description: The bottle number the sample was measured in

cr:field.name: Event
cr:field.description: A unique identifier similar to "Sample ID" that marks the event

cr:field.name: Rosette_Position
cr:field.description: An identifier for the position of a bottle on the CTD rosette

cr:field.name: Platform
cr:field.description: The name or identifier of a platform from which sampling was taken

cr:field.name: BIOPOLE
cr:field.description: A boolean flag to mark whether a sample was take on a study associated with (but not funded by) the BIOPOLE campaign (True), or not (False)

cr:field.name: Freshwater
cr:field.description: A boolean flag to mark whether a sample is freshwater (True) or not (False)

cr:field.name: Freshwater_Source
cr:field.description: A short description of the type of freshwater source for freshwater samples e.g "River"

cr:field.name: Land_Based
cr:field.description: Geographic flag indicating whether the sample location falls on land rather than ocean. Determined using a high-resolution (10 m) global coastline dataset and a point-in-polygon spatial test (Shapely/GEOS). TRUE where the sample’s latitude/longitude intersects land polygons; FALSE otherwise. Used for distinguishing terrestrial samples, river mouths, and shoreline artefacts from open-water observations. | Note: Please note, while effective this is an approximate method and should be treated with caution and manual inspection should be applied where nessecary.
